description: Record a person's review of an AI decision (approved, overridden or rejected; overriding or rejecting needs a `note`), by the rules of POST /v1/ai/records/{id}/review. Only call this with the decision a person actually made: never approve on your own judgement, because the record says a human reviewed it.

output_label.description: The outcome the person chose, when it differs.
